# @wordplus/realtime

> WordPlus Cloud's realtime SDK for sites and apps outside WordPress: rooms with emit, emitWithAck and volatile, presence and who is online, history, webhooks, calls between two people that ring in the browser, group calls, and the ready-made conversation window (`<chat-room>`), online list and call screen of Better Messages, sealed end to end. The app's server (this package's ./server for Node, wordplus/realtime-php for PHP and Laravel, wordplus-realtime for Python) declares rooms and calls by pattern and decides who may join them. The browser part (this package, ./react, ./native) connects to WordPlus Cloud, joins rooms and opens what arrives.

## Docs

All of them, with the pages of the PHP and Python packages, on the web: https://docs.wordplus.cloud/llms.txt. The server's code is shown for Node, PHP and Python alike.

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): the app in WordPlus Cloud, its key, secret and local key, the server's routes (Next.js, Express, Hono, Laravel, plain PHP, Django, FastAPI, Flask), connect() in the browser, a first room, and a site with no server of its own
- [Why WordPlus Cloud](docs/why.md): what the cloud runs and adds beside a framework's own websockets
- [Rooms](docs/rooms.md): names and patterns, declaring rooms and their rules, what a room keeps and allows, joining, history
- [Presence and who is online](docs/presence.md): a presence room's members, counting, rt.online across the app, <online-list>
- [Sending from your server](docs/sending.md): to().emit(), toUser(), except(), batch(), in() (count, members, history, forget, kick), webhooks
- [Events from the page](docs/events.md): a room's emit list, emit, emitWithAck, volatile, timeout, what an event carries in TypeScript, <chat-room>
- [Calls, group calls and the call screen](docs/calls.md): a token from your own route for each call, calls between two people, adding people, group calls, your camera and microphone, the device settings, backgrounds and AI noise removal, <call-button>, testing a call, end reasons
- [Live streams](docs/streams.md): a host live to an audience from a browser, a phone or OBS, its chat, reactions and moderation, <live-stream>
- [Elements](docs/elements.md): the ready-made parts with no framework: <call-screen>, <call-button>, <group-call-button>, <call-spot>, <chat-room>, <online-list>
- [Encryption and your users](docs/encryption.md): what is sealed, the local key, who gets which key, rotating, rt.users()
- [Vue](docs/vue.md): provideRealtime, useRoom, usePresence, useOnline, useProfiles, useTyping, useUserEvent, useCalls, useCall, useGroupCall, useStream as refs, VideoTrack, AudioTrack and StreamVideo, the ready-made screens as elements with isCustomElement, and Nuxt
- [Svelte](docs/svelte.md): provideRealtime, useRoom, usePresence, useOnline, useProfiles, useTyping, useUserEvent, useCalls, useCall, useGroupCall, useStream read as runes, the actions use:track and use:streamVideo, the ready-made screens as elements, and SvelteKit
- [Angular](docs/angular.md): provideRealtime, injectRoom, injectPresence, injectOnline, injectProfiles, injectTyping, injectUserEvent, injectCalls, injectCall, injectGroupCall, injectStream, injectTrack, injectStreamVideo as signals in standalone components, and the ready-made screens as elements with CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA
- [React, React Native and Capacitor](docs/react.md): RealtimeProvider, useRoom, usePresence, useOnline, useProfiles, useTyping, useUserEvent, useCalls, useGroupCall, Chat, OnlineList, @wordplus/realtime-ui's components in the app's own tree, the native entry for rooms, and in React Native calls and streams from @wordplus/realtime-react-native
- [React Native calls](https://docs.wordplus.cloud/react-native/calls/), [live streams](https://docs.wordplus.cloud/react-native/streams/) and [rooms](https://docs.wordplus.cloud/react-native/rooms/): @wordplus/realtime-react-native, a token from the app's own route, CallButton, useCall, useGroupCall, useStream, CallVideo, GroupVideo, StreamVideo, SystemCalls, on iOS for now, with rooms on both
- [Flutter calls](https://docs.wordplus.cloud/flutter/calls/), [live streams](https://docs.wordplus.cloud/flutter/streams/) and [rooms](https://docs.wordplus.cloud/flutter/rooms/): wordplus_realtime on iOS and Android, a token from the app's own route, CallButton, rt.startCall, rt.onIncomingCall, rt.joinGroupCall, rt.joinStream, rt.join
- [Customizing the screens](docs/customizing.md): the look, a piece of the app's own (components, CallControl, ::part(), <template slot>), the whole view copied (npx @wordplus/realtime-ui add, diff, update, accept, preview), what must keep working
- [Server reference](docs/server.md): createRealtime()'s options, rules, sending, routes
- [Browser reference](docs/browser.md): connect(), Realtime, Room, Online, Calls, Call, GroupCall, Stream
- [Errors](docs/errors.md): every refusal's code
- [Limits](docs/limits.md)

## For agents
